_comment: Copy to hardware.json and fill in ONLY what Collins/Salaar have confirmed. This example is for the ESP32 wearable (CP2102 USB-UART). Nothing here is a measurement: 'name', 'baud' and emg.output must be stated. Leave out imu.counts_per_g until the sensor and its range are confirmed: without it vibration stays in raw counts and the score is unavailable (by design). Confirm emg.output with `serial-check` ('emg is raw').
name: wearable-W
notes: Board W of the two wearable boards (both show the same USB serial number, so device_id picks the port). On Linux the port is /dev/ttyUSB*. DTR/RTS are wired to EN/IO0 for auto-reset: keeping both off avoids resetting the board on every open. The firmware is 921600 baud provisional until measured on the board. Example once an IMU is confirmed: "imu": {"model": "MPU-6050", "range_g": 2, "counts_per_g": 16384, "conversion_source": "MPU-6050 datasheet, sensitivity at the +/-2 g range"}.
